v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: Come * Let us glorify the Lord.

la: Iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints.

r.en: And give praise to the memory of his holiness.

text.la: Dóminus de cælo * prospéxit super fílios hóminum.
text.en: The Lord hath looked down from heaven * upon the children of men.

text.la: Qui operátur iustítiam * requiéscet in monte sancto tuo, Dómine.
text.en: He who worketh justice * may rest on thy holy mountain, O Lord.

text.la: Inclína, Dómine, * aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
text.en: O Lord, incline * thy ear to me, and hear my voice, my Lord.

text.la: Retríbuet mihi Dóminus * secúndum iustítiam meam.
text.en: The Lord will reward me * according to my justice.

text.la: Exáudiat te * Dóminus in die tribulatiónis. ‡
text.en: May the Lord hear * thee in the day of tribulation. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * in virtúte tua lætábitur rex. ‡
text.en: The king rejoices * in Thy strength, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Exaltábo te, * Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me. ‡
text.en: I will extol thee, * O Lord, for thou hast upheld me. ‡

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine Iesu Christe, preces servórum tuórum, et miserére nobis: Qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: O Lord Jesus Christ, graciously hear the prayers of Thy servants, and have mercy upon us, Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, ever world without end.

benedictio.la: Benedictióne perpétua benedícat nos Pater ætérnus.
benedictio.en: May the Eternal Father bless us with an eternal blessing.

source.en: Lesson from the first book of Kings

text.la: 28 Et respóndit rex David dicens: Vocáte ad me Bethsabée. Quæ cum fuísset ingréssa coram rege et stetísset ante eum, 29 Iurávit rex, et ait: Vivit Dóminus, qui éruit ánimam meam de omni angústia, 30 Quia, sicut iurávi tibi per Dóminum Deum Israël dicens: Sálomon fílius tuus regnábit post me et ipse sedébit super sólium meum pro me, sic fáciam hódie. 31 Summissóque Bethsabée in terram vultu, adorávit regem, dicens: Vivat dóminus meus David in ætérnum.
text.en: 28 And King David answered and said: Call to me Bethsabee. And when she was come in to the king, and stood before him, 29 The king swore and said: As the Lord liveth, who hath delivered my soul out of all distress, 30 Even as I swore to thee by the Lord the God of Israel, saying: Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead, so will I do this day. 31 And Bethsabee bowing with her face to the earth worshipped the king, saying: May my lord David live for ever

body.la: Recordáre, Dómine, testaménti tui, et dic Angelo percutiénti: Cesset iam manus tua,
body.en: Remember, O Lord, thy covenant, and say unto the destroying Angel: Stay now thine hand;

refrain.la: Ut non desolétur terra, et ne perdas omnem ánimam vivam.
refrain.en: That the land be not utterly laid waste, and that thou destroy not every living soul.

verse.la: Ego sum qui peccávi, ego qui iníque egi: isti qui oves sunt, quid fecérunt? Avertátur, óbsecro, furor tuus, Dómine, a pópulo tuo.
verse.en: Even I it is that have sinned, and done evil indeed; but these sheep, what have they done? Let thine anger, I pray thee, O Lord, be turned away from thy people.

benedictio.la: Unigénitus Dei Fílius nos benedícere et adiuváre dignétur.
benedictio.en: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, mercifully bless and keep us.

text.la: 32 Dixit quoque rex David: Vocáte mihi Sadoc sacerdótem et Nathan prophétam et Banáiam fílium Ióiadæ. Qui cum ingréssi fuíssent coram rege, 33 Dixit ad eos: tóllite vobíscum servos Dómini vestri, et impónite Salomónem fílium meum super mulam meam, et dúcite eum in Gihon, 34 Et ungat eum ibi Sadoc sacérdos et Nathan prophéta in regem super Israël. Et canétis búccina, atque dicétis: Vivat rex Sálomon. 35 Et ascendétis post eum, et véniet, et sedébit super sólium meum, et ipse regnábit pro me.
text.en: 32 King David also said: Call me Sadoc the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Banaias the son of Joiada. And when they were come in before the king, 33 He said to them: Take with you the servants of your lord, and set my son Solomon upon my mule: and bring him to Gihon. 34 And let Sadoc the priest, and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and you shall sound the trumpet, and shall say: God save king Solomon. 35 And you shall come up after him, and he shall come, and shall sit upon my throne, and he shall reign in my stead: and I will appoint him to be ruler over Israel, and over Juda.

body.la: Exaudísti, Dómine, oratiónem servi tui, ut ædificárem templum nómini tuo:
body.en: O Lord, Thou hast hearkened unto the prayer of thy servant, that I might build a temple unto thy Name,

refrain.la: Bénedic et sanctífica domum istam in sempitérnum, Deus Israël.
refrain.en: O God of Israel, bless Thou, and hallow this house for ever.

verse.la: Dómine, qui custódis pactum cum servis tuis, qui ámbulant coram te in toto corde suo.
verse.en: O Lord, Who keepest covenant with thy servants that walk before thee in all their heart.

benedictio.la: Spíritus Sancti grátia illúminet sensus et corda nostra.
benedictio.en: May the grace of the Holy Spirit enlighten all our hearts and minds.

text.la: 38 Descéndit ergo Sadoc sacérdos, et Nathan prophéta, et Banáias fílius Ióiadæ et Ceréthi, et Pheléthi: et imposuérunt Salomónem super mulam regis David, et adduxérunt eum in Gihon. 39 Sumpsítque Sadoc sacérdos cornu ólei de tabernáculo, et unxit Salomónem: et cecinérunt búccina, et dixit omnis pópulus: Vivat rex Sálomon. 40 Et ascéndit univérsa multitúdo post eum, et pópulus canéntium tíbiis, et lætántium gáudio magno: et insónuit terra a clamóre eórum.
text.en: 38 So Sadoc the priest, and Nathan the prophet went down, and Banaias the son of Joiada, and the Cerethi, and Phelethi: and they set Solomon upon the mule of king David, and brought him to Gihon. 39 And Sadoc the priest took a horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon: and they sounded the trumpet, and all the people said: God save king Solomon. 40 And all the multitude went up after him, and the people played with pipes, and rejoiced with a great joy, and the earth rang with the noise of their cry.

body.la: Audi, Dómine, hymnum et oratiónem, quam servus tuus orat coram te hódie, ut sint óculi tui apérti, et aures tuæ inténtæ,
body.en: Hearken, O Lord, unto the cry and to the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee today, that thine eyes may be open and thine ears attend;

refrain.la: Super domum istam die ac nocte.
refrain.en: Toward this house day and night.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Deus, cuius providéntia in sui dispositióne non fállitur: te súpplices exorámus; ut nóxia cuncta submóveas, et ómnia nobis profutúra concédas.
text.en: O God, Whose never-failing Providence ordereth all things both in heaven and earth, we humbly beseech thee to put away from us all hurtful things, and to give us those things which be profitable for us.

office.title: Feria secunda infra Hebd VII post Octavam Pentecostes
